::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** [March 1869]  
**Manuscript:** MS Mrs Clare Roels
:::

Cackle
Mother Goose having gone out on her broomstick she has had to delay the answers. They are not many in number this time, for [Chelsea China](people/person_329.qmd)’s popularity and [Windermere](people/person_1467.qmd)’s Wars of the Roses are decidedly the superior articles. [Cricket](people/person_1603.qmd) is the next to ask the questions.

[Mignonette](people/person_1637.qmd) and [Sparrow Hawk](people/person_97.qmd) retire

---

**Note:** Black-edged paper. This seems to be the only surviving example of a 'Cackle', one of the circular letters with which CMY communicated with the members of the [Gosling Society](organizations/other_104.qmd).
